countable.evidence: Spanish Ministry CER.es lists Museo de Salamanca inventory 104 as canvas painting explicitly Saint Isidore of Seville.

countable.title: San Isidoro de Sevilla
countable.museum: Instituto Andaluz del Patrimonio Histórico: Church collection, Seville
countable.evidence: Andalusian heritage inventory depicts exact Archbishop Isidore, staff, book and authored titles; separately inventoried object 47113; not Isidore the Farmer.

countable.title: Saint Grégoire de Nazianze (in four Fathers ensemble)
countable.medium: one of four separate oil-on-canvas originals, copied from earlier painted composition
countable.evidence: French official inventory corrects protection-order erroneous identification of Saint Denis to Saint Gregory Nazianzen; Saint Gregory is on a separate original canvas within four-painting ensemble, not the Louvre/Bazas Bertin B745.
countable.qualityGate: COPIED_COMPOSITION_REPAINTED_ICONOGRAPHY_CONFUSION: detailed description calls figure a Roman Pope despite Nazianzen label; research alternate only not premium art approval

holds.title: San Isidoro de Sevilla
holds.reason: Exact 1480–90 oil oak panel (CE0951/001), but Flemish-Gothic early style; historical fallback outside preferred naturalistic painting aesthetic.

qualityPolicy: Distinct physical original is not automatically a strong aesthetic option, a master file, or app approval. Existing score 0-2 globally excludes a painting.
